beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks whose roof gets repaired and who is left outside.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its workers challenge grand answers that praise dignity while underpaying actual labor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Those Who Need the Question, then meet the fictional ordinary witnesses.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to test your answers against care, freedom, and the lives they affect.
